description: This file contains shell script functions and configuration for managing DHCPv6 protocol settings in a network interface, including functions for initialization, setup, renewal, and teardown.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_init_config
methods.description: Initializes DHCPv6 protocol configuration variables with default values and possible options.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_add_prefix
methods.description: Appends an IPv6 prefix to a prefix list.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_add_sendopts
methods.description: Adds send options to the DHCPv6 command if provided.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_setup
methods.description: Sets up DHCPv6 configuration for a specific network interface using parameters retrieved from JSON and environment, then executes the DHCP client.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_renew
methods.description: Signals the DHCPv6 client to renew its lease via SIGUSR1.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_teardown
methods.description: Kills the DHCPv6 process associated with the interface, effectively tearing down the DHCPv6 configuration.
